_doc: Registered exceptions for the meta self-check (#48, scripts/self_check_docs.py). A document lands here only when it must quote catalogue material in RUNNING PROSE — where the #69 markup pre-pass cannot separate evidence from voice without falsifying the document. Every entry carries a reason and a ceiling pinned to the measured value plus a 0.01 tolerance, and always strictly below 1.0 — a ceiling at the score maximum could never be breached, because classifier scores are capped there; the ceiling is a ratchet, so a registered document that gets worse still fails, and one that becomes clean loses its entry (tests/test_self_check_docs.py enforces both). Same shape and same discipline as eval/fp_baseline.json.

CHANGELOG.md.reason: Names the phrases and buzzwords each release added, in running prose ('serves as a testament', 'cutting-edge', 'widely regarded as'; #104: 'it is worth noting', 'in today's [X]'). Quoting the catalogue is what a changelog for a phrase database does; removing the terms would make the entries unreadable. Evidence, not slop (#23). Ceiling raised 0.9829 -> 0.995 for the #104 Slice A entry (measured 0.990).

report.md.reason: Gap-analysis report; enumerates the Tier-1 buzzwords it found in the surveyed tools (realm, delve, tapestry, synergy) as its subject matter.

docs/no-ai-slop-coverage.md.reason: Issue #104 Slice A: Mapping-Tabelle Doku<->SSOT. Ihr Gegenstand ist der Phrasenkatalog selbst — jede Zeile nennt die gemappte Form im Original (hedging, opening formulas), deshalb schlaegt der Lauftext-Check an. Ceilung gemessen 0.932 + 0.01.
